## Say Halo 0.8.36
- Your shortcut key now keeps working while another app has secure keyboard entry on, such as a password field in your browser. Before, the key did nothing until you clicked out of that field.

## Say Halo 0.8.35
- With "Tap to toggle recording" on, every press of your shortcut key now starts or stops recording, however long you hold it. Before, a press held a little too long was ignored, so the next press started a silent recording. - Holding the shortcut key no longer risks stopping and restarting a recording.

## Say Halo 0.8.34
- If a dictation comes back with no words, the menu bar now says "No speech heard" instead of doing nothing. - If the microphone was silent, it says "Mic was silent. Check your input." - Say Halo keeps the audio from your last 10 empty dictations on your Mac so problems can be diagnosed.

## Say Halo 0.8.33
- The first time you open Say Halo, Setup walks you through one step at a time. - Input Monitoring is no longer required. - Until Accessibility is turned on, your dictation is copied to the clipboard and a "Copied" notice tells you so. Paste it wherever you need it. - Settings now has four pages: General, History, Replace and Setup. - The Replace list shows your newest replacements first, and its controls stay in reach while you scroll. - Shortcuts show key names, like "⌥ Option", instead of symbols alone.

## Say Halo 0.8.32
- Pause Media works with browsers again. SoundCloud, YouTube and other Chrome or Safari audio now pauses while you record and resumes when you stop, instead of only being muted.

## Say Halo 0.8.31
- Fully silence headphones and other outputs while recording when Say Halo mutes instead of pausing. Your earlier mute setting and volume come back when you stop.

# Say Halo 0.8.30
- Honor saved word replacements such as “11 Labs” → “Eleven Labs,” including when speech recognition spells out the number. - Keep paused browser videos paused when dictation ends. - Temporarily mute volume when active playback cannot be confirmed, including during browser calls. - Avoid reopening a closed music player during recording cleanup. - Preserve your existing recording and audio settings.

# Say Halo 0.8.29
- New **Automatically check for updates** switch in Settings → General. It shows whether Say Halo keeps itself up to date. - Automatic updates are turned back on for every install. Some Macs had them switched off with no way to see it, so new versions never showed up on their own. - Say Halo now checks every 4 hours instead of once a day. New versions download in the background, and an Install row appears in the Say Halo menu when one is ready.
Existing settings, saved word replacements, models, and permissions are preserved. You can turn automatic updates off again in Settings.

# Say Halo 0.8.28
- Fixes the microphone getting stuck after screen sharing or switching audio devices. Say Halo no longer sits at "Warming up…" or "Mic stopped" until you quit and reopen it. - If the microphone stops responding, Say Halo replaces it with a fresh connection within a few seconds. Reconnect works again instead of doing nothing. - A microphone that looks on but sends no sound is now detected and rebuilt before your next dictation. - As a last resort, Say Halo quietly restarts itself in the menu bar, after any dictation in progress finishes.
Existing settings, saved word replacements, models, and permissions are preserved.

# Say Halo 0.8.27
- A compact menu puts recording controls and microphone selection in one row. Start or stop with the circular control and choose an input directly from the menu. - See your last transcript and when it was created. Hover to preview more, then click anywhere on the row to copy the full text. - Save word replacements directly in the menu with From → To and the plus button, or press Enter. The saved count and Manage link sit beside Quick replace. - Microphone-health checks can retry a stopped recording connection once and show Reconnect if capture remains unavailable. Quiet pauses are treated as normal. - Downloaded updates appear as a clear install-and-restart row. Settings and Quit keep their standard keyboard shortcuts. - Cleaner text, a bright copy icon, a solid menu background, compact microphone options, and a right-aligned device name improve readability.
Existing settings, saved word replacements, models, and permissions are preserved.
